text:
A young tiger named Sheru lived alone in the forest and ate the same raw meat every day. One evening, he smelled something amazing drifting from a village kitchen—biryani. He crept closer and watched an old cook layer rice, spices and meat in a pot. Sheru decided he had to learn this magic.

The next night, Sheru borrowed a pot and tried to copy what he'd seen. He burned the rice, forgot the salt and nearly set his tail on fire. But he kept trying. After many smoky disasters, he finally made a pot that smelled right. He took one bite and roared with joy.

Word spread through the forest. Soon, animals lined up at Sheru's den for Sunday biryani. The tiger who once hunted alone now cooked for everyone, and his kitchen became the warmest place in the jungle.
